rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for examining how two or more things are alike or different.

example.english: We compare the prices of the two hotels before deciding.
example.traditional: 我哋會比較兩間酒店嘅價錢先至決定。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wui5 bei2 gaau3 loeng5 gaan1 zau2 dim3 ge3 gaa3 cin2 sin1 zi3 kyut3 ding6

rows.meaning: say one thing is like another
rows.note: Use this when likening one thing to another, especially in an analogy or metaphor.

example.english: This essay uses the sea to compare life to constant change.
example.traditional: 呢篇文章用大海比喻人生嘅無常。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 man4 zoeng1 jung6 daai6 hoi2 bei2 jyu6 jan4 sang1 ge3 mou4 soeng4

rows.note: Use this for the positive sense that one thing measures up to or is comparable with another.

example.english: This little shop’s ramen can compare with those famous places.
example.traditional: 呢間小店嘅拉麵，比得上出名嗰幾間。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 siu2 dim3 ge3 laai1 min6 bei2 dak1 soeng6 ceot1 meng2 go2 gei2 gaan1

rows.note: Use this when saying that one thing does not measure up to or compare with another.

example.english: This old phone can’t compare with the new one.
example.traditional: 呢部舊電話比唔上新嗰部。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gau6 din6 waa2 bei2 m4 soeng6 san1 go2 bou6
